# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.0 Worker 1 Slot 84: Dynamic Epidemics, Venetian Double-Island Lazarettos, Habsburg Pestkordon & Wu Youxing Wenyi Lun (oe_dis_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_dynamic_diseases.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ==============================================================================
# Slot 84 Monthly Entry Point (Quarterly Staggered O(1), Rule #15 Gated)
# ==============================================================================

# Any non-rebel country scope (called from BYZ mainline Slot 84 or oe_dis_pulse fallback).
oe_dis_monthly = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_dis_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dis_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_dis_init value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { oe_dis_rule_is_off = yes }
		# O(1) sleep when Rule #15 is Off
	}
	else = {
		# Always sync caller synergies when caller is human
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no }
			oe_dis_sync_country_synergies = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { current_month = 1 }
			oe_dis_q1_venice_and_synergies = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { current_month = 4 }
			oe_dis_q2_tezoni_and_wenyi = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { current_month = 7 }
			oe_dis_q3_marseille_pestkordon_karantina = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { current_month = 10 }
			oe_dis_q4_diplomacy_and_triumph = yes
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Country-Scope Synergy Refresh (v9.8 Asclepius + v10.0/v12.5 Granaries + Mild Buffer)
# ==============================================================================

oe_dis_sync_country_synergies = {
	# 1. v9.8 Asclepius sanctuary synergy (Epidaurus / Pergamon + seated Asclepius)
	if = {
		limit = { oe_dis_has_asclepius_synergy = yes }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_asclepius_sanctuary_aegis_mod years = 2 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				oe_dis_country_infected_any = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis_ev10_done }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dis_ev10_done value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.10
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = oe_dis_asclepius_sanctuary_aegis_mod
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis_dev_synergy_pin }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = oe_dis_asclepius_sanctuary_aegis_mod
	}

	# 2. v10.0 / v12.5 Ever-Normal Granary epidemic relief synergy
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_dis_has_granary_relief = yes
			oe_dis_country_infected_any = yes
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_granary_epidemic_cushion_mod years = 2 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis_ev11_cd }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dis_ev11_cd years = 10 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.11
		}
	}

	# 3. Rule #15 Mild mode automatic relief buffer
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_dis_rule_is_mild = yes
			oe_dis_country_infected_any = yes
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_mild_buffer_mod years = 5 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis_ev14_cd }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_dis_ev14_cd years = 12 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.14
		}
	}

	# 4. 1750 Early Modern Quarantine Maturity milestone (exports oe_dis_quarantine_triumph = 1 for W4 Chronicle)
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			current_year >= 1745
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis_ev13_done }
			OR = {
				oe_dis_has_double_lazaretto = yes
				has_variable = oe_dis_sanita_established
				has_variable = oe_dis_pestkordon_enacted
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis_ev13_done value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis_quarantine_triumph value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.13
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Quarterly O(1) Historical Event Anchors (<= 6 Fixed Locations per Quarter)
# ==============================================================================

# Q1 (Jan): Venetian Double-Island Exemplar (1468+) & Patenti di Sanita Smuggling
oe_dis_q1_venice_and_synergies = {
	location:venice = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_ai = no
						is_rebel_country = no
						current_year >= 1468
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis_ev3_done }
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_dis_ev3_done value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.3
				}
			}
		}
	}
	location:dubrovnik = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_ai = no
						is_rebel_country = no
						current_year >= 1490
						oe_dis_has_any_lazaretto = yes
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis_ev4_cd }
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_dis_ev4_cd years = 25 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.4
				}
			}
		}
	}
	location:constantinople = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no }
					oe_dis_sync_country_synergies = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Q4 (Oct): Quarantine Embargo Diplomacy & Triumph Audit
oe_dis_q4_diplomacy_and_triumph = {
	location:genoa = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_ai = no
						is_rebel_country = no
						current_year >= 1520
						OR = {
							has_country_modifier = oe_dis_quarantena_strict_mod
							has_country_modifier = oe_dis_quarantena_nuovo_mod
							has_country_modifier = oe_dis_quarantena_granary_mod
						}
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis_ev12_cd }
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_dis_ev12_cd years = 20 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.12
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Dev Panel Page 81 Helpers (Stage wires directly to oe_dev.81)
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope. Hot-switches Rule #15 override to HISTORIC (1) and opens oe_dis.90 readout.
oe_dis_dev_set_mode_historic = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_dis_rule_override value = 1 }
	remove_country_modifier = oe_dis_mild_buffer_mod
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.90
}

# Country scope. Hot-switches Rule #15 override to MILD (2), applies mild buffer, and opens oe_dis.90 readout.
oe_dis_dev_set_mode_mild = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_dis_rule_override value = 2 }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_mild_buffer_mod years = 5 mode = replace }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.90
}

# Country scope. Hot-switches Rule #15 override to OFF (3) and opens oe_dis.90 readout.
oe_dis_dev_set_mode_off = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_dis_rule_override value = 3 }
	remove_country_modifier = oe_dis_mild_buffer_mod
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.90
}

# Country scope. Spawns oe_dis_levantine_plague in a coastal owned location (or capital fallback) and fires oe_dis.1.
oe_dis_dev_spawn_plague = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_owned_location = { is_coastal = yes }
		}
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_coastal = yes }
			spawn_disease = {
				disease = disease:oe_dis_levantine_plague
				value = 0.75
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = capital }
		capital = {
			spawn_disease = {
				disease = disease:oe_dis_levantine_plague
				value = 0.75
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.1
}

# Country scope. Spawns oe_dis_camp_fever in capital and fires oe_dis.2.
oe_dis_dev_spawn_camp_fever = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = capital }
		capital = {
			spawn_disease = {
				disease = disease:oe_dis_camp_fever
				value = 0.75
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.2
}

# Country scope. Instantly constructs Lazzaretto Vecchio, Lazzaretto Nuovo & Pestkordon Station (cost_multiplier = 0) and opens oe_dis.90.
oe_dis_dev_build_lazarettos = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_owned_location = { is_coastal = yes }
		}
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = { is_coastal = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_dis_lazzaretto_vecchio } }
				construct_building = {
					building_type = building_type:oe_dis_lazzaretto_vecchio
					instant = yes
					cost_multiplier = 0
					cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_dis_dev_free_build_tt"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_dis_lazzaretto_nuovo } }
				construct_building = {
					building_type = building_type:oe_dis_lazzaretto_nuovo
					instant = yes
					cost_multiplier = 0
					cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_dis_dev_free_build_tt"
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = capital }
		capital = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_dis_pestkordon_station } }
				construct_building = {
					building_type = building_type:oe_dis_pestkordon_station
					instant = yes
					cost_multiplier = 0
					cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_dis_dev_free_build_tt"
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = oe_dis_vecchio_built value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_dis_nuovo_built value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_dis_double_lazaretto_built value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_dis_pestkordon_built value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_dis_quarantine_triumph value = 1 }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.90
}

# Country scope. Showcases v9.8 Asclepius + v10.0/v12.5 Ever-Normal Granary synergies and fires oe_dis.10 & oe_dis.11.
oe_dis_dev_sim_synergy = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_dis_dev_synergy_pin value = 1 }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_asclepius_sanctuary_aegis_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis_granary_epidemic_cushion_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.10
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.11
}

# Country scope. Syncs synergies and opens the live Page 81 audit readout (oe_dis.90).
oe_dis_dev_readout = {
	oe_dis_sync_country_synergies = yes
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis.90
}
